## About
Princeton Auto Center is a car repair and maintenance shop on Washington Road in Princeton. We work on domestic and foreign vehicles, from everyday commuters to a Mercedes that needs a little extra care.
Our customers rate us 4.6 from 127 Google reviews. Reviewers tell us what matters to them: clear explanations before any work starts, fair pricing, and no pressure to buy things the car doesn't need.
Open weekdays and Saturday. Appointments are honored and drive-ins are welcome.

## Services
- Tuneups, brake service and suspension work: Tuneups, brake service, wheel balance and suspension work to keep your car driving right.
- Coolant flush and ignition coils: One reviewer brought in their Mercedes for a coolant flush, sparkplug replacements and ignition coils, and said we were honest about what needed to be done first.

## FAQ
Q: Are appointments honored, and are drive-ins welcomed?
A: Yes to both. Appointments are honored, and drive-ins are welcome too.

Q: Do you work on foreign vehicles?
A: Yes. We repair both domestic and foreign vehicles.

Q: What are your Saturday hours?
A: Saturday from 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM.
